rule: A run that fails before the provider boundary produced no measurement. It is replaced rather than retained, its replicate slot stays free, and a zero-spend receipt records the attempt so the corpus does not read as though the lane was never tried.

anthropic_attempt.why_retained_rather_than_replaced: It crossed the provider boundary and spent budget, so a zero-spend receipt would be false. But it priced five and a fraction of six tasks against six-task baselines, which is the named incomplete-execution invalidity condition, so it carries no comparison and must never be read as a LeanCTX result.

disclosed_numbers_policy: The Anthropic partial telemetry above is recorded for disclosure only and must never be published, compared, or ranked as a lane result.
operational_finding: A Claude Code replicate is two lanes of six tasks each, and one five-hour Anthropic window buys roughly one tool. Launching tools back to back until one fails partway wastes nearly a full lane's budget for nothing usable. Provider budget is a scheduling constraint on this study, not only a cost, and both accounts should be checked for remaining headroom before a launch rather than after a failure.
no_apparatus_defect: None of these failures indicates anything about the treatments or the apparatus. Every declared surface installed and every handshake passed where one was attempted; the runs were stopped by account limits external to the study.
